rules.statement: A lessee is not entitled to equitable relief against forfeiture of lease except on the ground that the penalty of forfeiture would be outrageous or 'immanis'.
rules.supporting_quote: "A lessee is granted relief against a provision for forfeiture of the lease unless there has been a notably grave and dandifying misuse of the property (Perera v. Thaliff 1). A clause of forfeiture is only intended as security for the due payment of the rent (Perera v. Perera 2)."
